description: Fabricated materials-study evidence for human comparison. The verdicts are reviewer annotations. They are not executable grounding rules.

source.text: The proposal will test how layering affects optical contrast. It plans microscopy on panels with 2–8 layers and a separate scattering study. The scattering series has no specified layer range.

A small reference panel made by chemical synthesis is already in hand and will be used in the primary calibration workflow. A different synthetic route is a fallback for the larger reference panel. The proposal identifies phase recovery as a risk because there is no matching reference model. It proposes two alternative calibration methods.

The durability aim uses commercially available panels and tests contrast after repeated handling independently of the reference-panel synthesis. The proposal specifies an untreated control. It gives no yield estimate for the larger reference panel.

reviewCases.output: The proposal plans microscopy on panels with 2–8 layers to test how layering affects optical contrast. It also proposes a separate scattering study without specifying a layer range. A chemically synthesized reference panel is already in hand for primary calibration. A different synthetic route is a fallback for the larger panel. The independent durability aim uses commercial panels and an untreated control. As a review consideration, the proposal does not specify the expected yield of the larger reference panel.
reviewCases.reviewerCheck: The range applies only to microscopy, the existing panel is part of the primary method, and the missing yield is limited to the larger panel.

reviewCases.output: The microscopy and scattering experiments will each use panels spanning 2–24 layers.
reviewCases.reviewerCheck: The source gives 2–8 layers for microscopy and no range for scattering. Reject the unsupported range and its extension to both experiments.

reviewCases.output: Chemical synthesis is outside the primary workflow and appears only as a contingency.
reviewCases.reviewerCheck: The primary calibration uses a chemically synthesized panel that already exists. Only the alternative route for the larger panel is a fallback.

reviewCases.output: Phase recovery has no precedent, and the entire program depends on successful synthesis of the larger panel.
reviewCases.reviewerCheck: A missing matching reference model does not establish absence of precedent. The proposal lists alternatives, and the durability aim is independent of synthesis.

reviewCases.output: The larger panel cannot be made at usable yield.
reviewCases.reviewerCheck: The proposal omits a yield estimate. Report that omission as a review consideration without inferring an unusable yield.
